name: Smart Import Wanted Reconciliation Fix
changes: Fixes Wanted remaining on the pre-import dynamic-range state after a successful Smart Import upgrade that already satisfies the active profile target.

Makes dynamic-range evidence confidence-aware: positive lightweight media-probe signatures can confirm, promote, or correct traits, while an all-negative bounded probe no longer erases explicit release traits.
Stamps successful Smart Import release traits as the authoritative post-import Automation state so a newly imported Dolby Vision + HDR fallback release immediately satisfies 4K Preferred.
Keeps pre-v3.6.88 optimistic DV/HDR provenance correctable by allowing one same-rank preferred replacement while that legacy current trait remains unconfirmed and below target.
Prevents corrective replacement loops because v3.6.88 imports become trusted post-import records; same-rank DV replacements are rejected after a DV import while DV -> DV+HDR remains eligible.
Preserves v3.6.86 cache-snapshot performance, SABnzbd 5.1.2, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 and frozen Newsgroup Browser behavior.
regression_guards: Fresh Smart Import of DV+HDR remains DV+HDR for Wanted even when the lightweight media probe returns no positive dynamic-range signature.
Fresh DV-only import remains Wanted only for the higher DV+HDR target and rejects another same-rank DV replacement.
Legacy unconfirmed DV provenance can still accept one corrective same-rank DV candidate, preserving the v3.6.87 user-reported fix without download loops.
Wanted persistence is validated after serializing and reloading the library record from disk.
v3.6.86 one-cache-read summary/search behavior and frozen unrelated subsystems remain guarded.
